answer: Score agents on correlated mistakes. Split each test through a prism of small independent sub-questions, then compare the wrong answers across accounts. Honest agents err in different ways, while keys run by one operator share the same model, prompts and blind spots, so their errors line up. Pairs whose wrong answers match far above chance split one reward instead of collecting two. Over a long horizon the evidence compounds, and a farm's payout sinks to its nadir, roughly one share however many keys it runs. Correct answers raise no suspicion; only shared errors count.
